$comment: The dressing kit: the small architectural parts that make an autogenerated building look lived in. Rich, 2026-09-28: 'a buildings dressing kit for windows, doors, gutters, driveways, other common architectural features - something we could attach to autogenerated buildings to make them feel alive.' THESE ARE NOT PROPS. A prop stands somewhere; a dressing part ATTACHES — a window goes in a wall opening, a gutter follows a roof edge, a driveway meets the kerb. So every entry carries an `attach` block saying where it goes and how it is sized, and that block is the part the building generator reads. Without it this is just a catalogue of small meshes and the buildings stay dead. Sizes are in METRES and they are real: a US residential garage door is 2.44 m tall, a UK front door 1.98 m. The generator scales an opening to the part, not the part to the opening, because a door that is 2.6 m tall reads as a warehouse whatever the wall around it says.
